Seal packet against candidate manifest; upload immutable packet
Backup 3 existing function definitions and prepare rollback SQL; apply only migration125 after core review
Deploy only independent n15 using existing model profiles; verify runtime source hashes and explicit schema profile
New isolated Kafka/Fusion ingest once (4 alerts,4 raw events,2 incidents), five fused receipts including one exact synthetic replay
Root semantic review of saved first C; stop card on failure

Root review both complete chains; restore independent selected profile explicitly
semantic_expectations: Maintenance fixture oracle is benign but authorization is withheld until H
needs_review acceptable, not counted as determined correct
process_start+success does not establish script completion or authorization
connection+success and TCP/443 do not establish HTTPS, process attribution or exfiltration
known remote IP must not be described as missing
H confirms A0 process task authorization only; A1 remains unconfirmed
second C must freeze H revision and prior accepted model result; trace to artifacts
pairing_limit: One semantically paired maintenance scenario; independent identities, hosts and windows prevent predecessor contamination. Does not estimate population accuracy or complete malicious/sparse scenario coverage.
migration_scope: 125 replaces three functions only; no table/column changes, old Run edits or repeated bootstrap. Rollback script retained for separate review, never automatic.
credential_handling: Identity and api.env remain server-side; no values or credential-derived hashes exported. Protected config comparisons are server-local, exported as boolean only.

offline_checks.initial_failure: Datetime rebase parentheses error; corrected before successful offline replay.
offline_checks.scope: temporary synthetic manifest and packet only; no network or business writes

remaining: Actual n15 candidate manifest and seal
ingest_guards: Before any models, require exactly two distinct incidents; each must contain exactly its declared two alert IDs, with no extra member or cross-backend merge.

page_acceptance.browser_credentials: No user credential or credential hash. Enter only the public marker local-acceptance; it is not an API key.
page_acceptance.authentication: Real API key remains on 21. Locally generated relay nonce stays only in local/remote Python memory, passed via SSH stdin and not logged or persisted.
page_acceptance.network: Both HTTP servers and SSH forwarding bind 127.0.0.1. Same-origin, Host, Referer and Sec-Fetch-Site checks on local API relay. Redirects disabled on credential-bearing upstream.
page_acceptance.allowed: GET paths scoped to exactly one card Case, POST /tasks once and PUT only the task created by this session. Read-only mode denies every write.
browser_steps: After first C root semantic review, open printed URL; use printed service_base and public marker local-acceptance
Save one completed H explicitly covering process alert A0 only, using the approved authorization statement; inspect/edit its metadata and history
Ctrl-C closes remote session and SSH tunnel; export saved page-H-task and page-session-end
Root reviews exact H task/revision and its closed session; upload page-human-review before second
page_acceptance.second_behavior: Verify session closed and reviewed H matches current saved task exactly; record H provenance, then prepare/start only. Never POST another H. A card with a prior write-session cannot choose driver-created H.
page_acceptance.backend_note: Replace deepseek with small to use that independent card. If small does not use the page, second --human-source driver is explicit and refused when a page write-session exists.
page_acceptance.verification_limit: Five offline checks cover packet identity, review binding, route deny rules, H immutable readback and no duplicate H create. No browser/remote proxy session started yet.
